        "contents": "    }\n}\n\npublic extension View {\n    /// Adds an animated shimmering effect to any view, typically to show that an operation is in progress.\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - active: Convenience parameter to conditionally enable the effect. Defaults to &#96;&#96;Shimmer/defaultGradient&#96;&#96;.\n    ///   - bandSize: The size of the animated mask's \"band\". Defaults to 0.3 unit points, which corresponds to\n    /// 20% of the extent of the gradient.\n    @ViewBuilder func shimmering(\n        active: Bool = true,\n        animation: Animation = Shimmer.defaultAnimation,\n        gradient: Gradient? = nil,\n        bandSize: CGFloat = 0.3,\n        color: Color? = nil,\n        mode: Shimmer.Mode = .mask\n    ) -&gt; some View {\n        modifier(ConditionalShimmer(active: active, animation: animation, gradient: gradient, bandSize: bandSize, color: color, mode: mode))\n    }\n\n    /// Adds an animated shimmering effect to any view, typically to show that an operation is in progress.\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - active: Convenience parameter to conditionally enable the effect. max(0, min(1, fallbackElapsed / expected)) : 0\n                distanceFromStart = totalDistance * progress\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Fallback: use expectedTravelTime proportion if available (start appears stationary)",

The code compiles. Summary of changes:

## Summary

Fixed the `ShimmeringRoutePolyline` animation. The issue was that `routeShimmerProgress` was set from 0 to 1 once with `withAnimation`, but `ShimmeringRoutePolyline` expects a continuously incrementing `progress` (it uses `truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 1)` for looping).

### Changes made:

1. Added a separate timer for the shimmer animation (`shimmerTimerCancellable`) to avoid conflicts with the existing auto-update timer.

2. Added `shimmerAnimationStartTime` to track when the animation started for time-based progress calculation.

3. Implemented `startShimmerAnimation()`:
   - Starts a timer that updates every ~16ms (60fps)
   - Calculates progress based on elapsed time since the start
   - Progress continuously increases, and `ShimmeringRoutePolyline` handles the looping via `truncatingRemainder`

4. Implemented `stopShimmerAnimation()` to clean up the timer and reset state.

5. Added lifecycle management:
   - Starts in `onAppear`
   - Stops in `onDisappear`
   - Restarts when `animationsAllowed` changes

The animation should now continuously loop along the route polyline. The shimmer effect moves along the route based on the `direction` setting in the configuration (forward or backward).

            "text": "3. **Keep settings as the primary toggle**",

            "text": "  - Leave existing settings checks (&#96;settings.pulsingMapMarkers&#96;) intact at call sites in:",

          {

          {
            "text": "5. **Gate all other animations and transitions**",

          {

        "contents": "---\nname: low-power-gate-effects\noverview: Add a shared Low Power/scene-phase gate so shimmer and pulsing map effects only render when enabled in settings and not in Low Power Mode.\ntodos:\n  - id: add-animation-gate\n    content: Add shared animationsAllowed environment gate.\n    status: completed\n  - id: gate-shimmer-pulse\n    content: Gate shimmer and pulsing via animationsAllowed.\n    status: completed\n  - id: audit-other-animations\n    content: Disable remaining animations/transitions in LPM.\n    status: completed\n  - id: verify-behavior\n    content: Verify LPM disables all animations.\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# Low Power Mode Gating Plan\n\n## Summary\n\nImplement a shared animation-permission gate (based on Low Power Mode + scene phase) and apply it to shimmer, pulsing, and all other animations/transitions. Keep existing settings checks (e.g., &#96;settings.pulsingMapMarkers&#96;) so effects only render when enabled and the device is not in power save.\n\n## Key Files\n\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/Shimmer.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/Shimmer.swift)&#96;\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/PulsingAccuracyCircle.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/PulsingAccuracyCircle.swift)&#96;\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/MapHelpers.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/Map/MapHelpers.swift)&#96; (or another shared file for the global animation gate)\n- &#96;[/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceMapView.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/Devices%20Views/iPhone_DeviceMapView.swift)&#96; and all other map views using animations\n\n## Plan\n\n1. **Create a shared “animations allowed” environment gate**\n  - Extend the existing Low Power Mode listener (currently in &#96;ShimmerGate&#96;) into a reusable environment value such as &#96;animationsAllowed&#96; that encodes: &#96;scenePhase == .active &amp;&amp; !isLowPowerMode&#96;.",

Properties\n    @Published var disableDeviceAutolock: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(disableDeviceAutolock, forKey: Keys.disableDeviceAutolock) }\n    }\n    @Published var indicateAccuracyOnMap: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(indicateAccuracyOnMap, forKey: Keys.indicateAccuracyOnMap) }\n    }\n    @Published var groupsZoomToFit: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(groupsZoomToFit, forKey: Keys.groupsZoomToFit) }\n    }\n    @Published var miataruServerURL: String {\n        didSet {\n            defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(\n                serverURL: miataruServerURL,\n                deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },\n                ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            )\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var trackAndReportLocation: Bool {\n        didSet { \n            defaults.set(trackAndReportLocation, forKey: Keys.trackAndReportLocation)\n            // Check location permissions when tracking is enabled\n            if trackAndReportLocation {\n                checkAndRequestLocationPermissions()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    @Published var saveLocationHistoryOnServer: Bool {\n        didSet { defaults.set(saveLocationHistoryOnServer, forKey: Keys.saveLocationHistoryOnServer) }\n    }\n    @Published var locationDataRetentionTime: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(locationDataRetentionTime), forKey: \"location_data_retention_time\") }\n    }\n    @Published var mapType: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapType), forKey: Keys.mapType) }\n    }\n    @Published var mapUpdateInterval: Int {\n        didSet { defaults.set(String(mapUpdateInterval), forKey: Keys.mapUpdateInterval) }",

        "contents": "/// )\n/// &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nstruct PulsingAccuracyCircle: View {\n    @Environment(\\.animationsAllowed) private var animationsAllowed\n\n    @State private var isPulsing = false\n\n    // MARK: - Configurable parameters (edit in one place)\n    /// The base color used to render the core and halos.\n    let pulsingColor: Color\n    /// Base diameter (in points) of the core circle. The view reserves extra\n    /// headroom based on &#96;haloMaxScale&#96; to prevent clipping when halos expand.\n    let size: CGFloat\n    /// Maximum outward scale factor for halo expansion relative to &#96;size&#96;.\n    let haloMaxScale: CGFloat\n    /// Opacity of the stable core circle (kept at 1.0 scale).\n    let coreOpacity: Double\n    /// Opacity of the first (earlier) halo.\n    let halo1Opacity: Double\n    /// Opacity of the second (later) halo.\n    let halo2Opacity: Double\n    /// Duration (seconds) for one ease-out cycle (repeats forever with autoreverse).\n    let animationDuration: Double\n    /// Start delay (seconds) for halo 1 animation to create staggered rhythm.\n    let halo1Delay: Double\n    /// Start delay (seconds) for halo 2 animation to create staggered rhythm.\n    let halo2Delay: Double\n\n    /// Easing used for the repeating pulse. Defined from parameters to keep\n    /// animation behavior centralized.\n    private var easeGently: Animation {\n        Animation.easeOut(duration: animationDuration).repeatForever(autoreverses: true)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new pulsing accuracy indicator.\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - pulsingColor: Base color for the core and halos.\n    ///   - size: Core diameter in points.         "contents": "class InfoOverlayManager: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var message: String = \"\"\n    @Published var visible: Bool = false\n\n    private var hideCancellable: AnyCancellable?\n\n    func show(message: String, duration: TimeInterval = 3.0, animationsAllowed: Bool = true) {\n        self.message = message\n        if animationsAllowed {\n            withAnimation {\n                self.visible = true\n            }\n        } else {\n            self.visible = true\n        }\n        hideCancellable?.cancel()\n        hideCancellable = Just(())\n            .delay(for: .seconds(duration), scheduler: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                if animationsAllowed {\n                    withAnimation {\n                        self?.visible = false\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    self?.visible = false\n                }\n            }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    InfoOverlay(message: \"This is an example info message!\", visible: true)\n        .background(Color.gray.opacity(0.2))\n        .edgesIgnoringSafeArea(.all)\n}",

        "contents": "                    }\n                }\n        }\n        .onChange(of: scenePhase) {\n            switch scenePhase {\n            case .active:\n                LocationManager.shared.appDidEnterForeground()\n            case .background:\n                LocationManager.shared.appDidEnterBackground()\n            default:\n                break\n            }\n        }\n        WindowGroup(for: String.self) { deviceID in\n            DeviceWindowEntrypoint(deviceID: deviceID)\n                .environmentObject(RouteInfoState.shared)\n                .environmentObject(SettingsManager.shared)\n                .animationsGate()\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = url.host ?? \"\"\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow",
        "signatures": {},

Server Update Status\n    enum ServerUpdateStatus {\n        case idle\n        case updating\n        case success\n        case failed(String)\n    }\n    \n    struct UpdateLogEntry: Identifiable {\n        let id = UUID()\n        let timestamp: Date\n        let mode: String\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - ## Summary of Fixes

Fixed the shimmer animation for `ShimmeringRoutePolyline`. Changes:

### 1. **Fixed the shimmer rendering** (`ShimmeringRoutePolyline.swift`)
   - Replaced `LinearGradient` (screen-space, doesn't follow the polyline path) with a solid color
   - The animated dash phase now moves along the polyline path

### 2. **Fixed the animation timer** (`iPhone_DeviceNavigationView.swift`)
   - Switched from `Timer.publish().sink` to a `Task`-based loop
   - Runs on `@MainActor` to safely update `@State`
   - Updates `routeShimmerProgress` every ~16ms (60fps)

### 3. **Added lifecycle management**
   - Starts animation in `onAppear`
   - Restarts when route changes (via `onChange(of: route)`)
   - Restarts when `animationsAllowed` changes
   - Stops in `onDisappear`

### How it works:
- The base polyline renders in blue (4pt width)
- The shimmer overlay renders as white dashes (6pt width) on top
- The `dashPhase` animates continuously, creating a moving dash effect
- Direction is controlled by `phaseSign` (forward = -1, backward = +1)

The shimmer should now be visible as white animated dashes moving along the blue route polyline, indicating the route direction. The animation loops continuously while the route is displayed.
